lines.text: How has the neck been since I saw you?
Worse since the weekend. The pain in my right side of the neck goes into the shoulder blade.
Only in the right hand, sometimes at night.
On examination there is tenderness over the right upper trapezius. I explained the risks of needling.
I understand, and I'm all good for a crack so happy to proceed.
Thank you. Today we did dry needling.
